purpose: Separate common lexical meanings from the concrete historical images needed in the high-reuse 歹, 止, and 角 component families.

歹.reason: Bad is the common lexical meaning, while the graph depicts skeletal remains and death is the concrete image behind its descendant family.

止.reason: Stop is the common lexical meaning, while the graph is a foot pictograph and foot makes movement descendants easier to remember.

角.reason: Angle is the common lexical meaning, while the graph depicts an animal horn and horn is the concrete image reused in descendants.
